parts: 在太平洋瓦努阿图群岛的埃法特岛上，一项重要的考古发现揭示了一个古代航海民族的踪迹。他们是今天波利尼西亚人的远祖。

10.en: The Lapita left precious few clues about themselves, but Efate expands the volume of data available to researchers dramatically.
parts: 拉皮塔人留下的有关自身的线索少之又少，但埃法特岛的发现大大增加了研究者可用的资料。

13.en: ‘It’s an important discovery’, says Matthew Spriggs, professor of archaeology at the Australian National University and head of the international team digging up the site, ‘for it conclusively identifies the remains as Lapita.’
parts: “这是一项重要的发现，”马修·斯普里格斯说。
他是澳大利亚国立大学考古学教授，也是发掘这一遗址的国际团队负责人。
“因为这确凿地表明，这些遗骸属于拉皮塔人。”

17.en: There is one stubborn question for which archaeology has yet to provide any answers: how did the Lapita accomplish the ancient equivalent of a moon landing, many times over?
parts: 有一道难题，考古学至今还没能给出答案：拉皮塔人如何一次又一次完成了在古代堪比登月的壮举？

21.en: Those sailing skills, he says, were developed and passed down over thousands of years by earlier mariners who worked their way through the archipelagoes of the western Pacific, making short crossings to nearby islands.
parts: 他说，这些航海技能是更早的航海者历经数千年发展并传承下来的。
他们在西太平洋的各个群岛间逐步前行，每次短途航行到附近的岛屿。

29.en: Once out there, skilled seafarers would have detected abundant leads to follow to land: seabirds, coconuts and twigs carried out to sea by the tides, and the afternoon pile-up of clouds on the horizon which often indicates an island in the distance.
parts: 到了海上，有经验的航海者想必会发现许多能引导他们找到陆地的线索：
海鸟，被潮水带到海上的椰子和小树枝，
以及午后堆聚在地平线上的云团——云团往往预示着远处有岛。

32.en: Vanuatu, for example, stretches more than 500 miles in a northwest-southeast trend, its scores of intervisible islands forming a backstop for mariners riding the trade winds home.
parts: 以瓦努阿图为例，群岛沿西北至东南方向绵延五百多英里。
几十座彼此可以望见的岛屿，给乘信风返乡的航海者提供了最后一道保障。

38.en: El Niño, the same climate disruption that affects the Pacific today, may have helped scatter the Lapita, Anderson suggests.
parts: 安德森认为，如今仍影响太平洋的厄尔尼诺气候异常现象，当年可能也促使拉皮塔人分散到了各地。

40.en: By reversing the regular east-to-west flow of the trade winds for weeks at a time, these ‘super El Niños’ might have taken the Lapita on long unplanned voyages.
parts: 这些“超级厄尔尼诺”现象每次都使通常自东向西吹的信风反向持续数周，可能就这样把拉皮塔人带上了原本未曾计划的长途航程。

43.en: They probably never numbered more than a few thousand in total, and in their rapid migration eastward they encountered hundreds of islands - more than 300 in Fiji alone.
parts: 他们的总人数很可能从未超过几千人，
却在迅速东迁途中遇到数百座岛屿，单是斐济就有三百多座。

7.en: This all amounts to heightened activity and noise levels, which have the potential to be particularly serious for children experiencing auditory function deficit.
parts: 这些都意味着课堂活动增多，噪声水平升高。
对听觉功能有障碍的儿童来说，这种情况可能尤其严重。

39.en: It is imperative that the needs of these children are taken into account in the setting of appropriate international standards to be promulgated in future.
parts: 在制定日后将颁布的相关国际标准时，务必考虑这些儿童的需要。

26.en: These levels come from outside activities that penetrate the classroom structure, from teaching activities, and other noise generated inside, which can be exacerbated by room reverberation.
parts: 这些噪声来自穿过教室围护结构传入的室外活动声，也来自教学活动和室内产生的其他声音。
室内的混响还会使噪声加剧。

27.en: Strategies are needed to obtain the optimum classroom construction and perhaps a change in classroom culture and methods of teaching.
parts: 需要采取措施，把教室建得尽可能适合教学。课堂文化和教学方法或许也需要改变。

5.en: Modern teaching practices, the organisation of desks in the classroom, poor classroom acoustics, and mechanical means of ventilation such as air-conditioning units all contribute to the number of children unable to comprehend the teacher’s voice.
parts: 现代教学方式、课桌的摆放、不良的教室声学环境，以及空调等机械通风设备，
都会使更多儿童听不懂老师说的话。

6.en: Education researchers Nelson and Soli have also suggested that recent trends in learning often involve collaborative interaction of multiple minds and tools as much as individual possession of information.
parts: 教育研究者纳尔逊和索利还提出，近年的学习往往既涉及多人和多种工具之间的协作互动，
也同样涉及个人对信息的掌握。
terms: 多人的思考与多种工具

8.en: Noise in classrooms can only exacerbate their difficulty in comprehending and processing verbal communication with other children and instructions from the teacher.
parts: 教室里的噪声只会让这些儿童更难理解和处理两类口头信息：他们与其他儿童交流时听到的话，以及老师的指令。

11.en: The International Institute of Noise Control Engineering (I-INCE), on the advice of the World Health Organization, has established an international working party, which includes New Zealand, to evaluate noise and reverberation control for school rooms.
parts: 国际噪声控制工程学会（I-INCE）根据世界卫生组织的建议，成立了一个有新西兰参与的国际工作组，
负责评估学校教室的噪声与混响控制。

12.en: While the detrimental effects of noise in classroom situations are not limited to children experiencing disability, those with a disability that affects their processing of speech and verbal communication could be extremely vulnerable.
parts: 课堂噪声的不良影响并不限于有障碍的儿童，
不过，如果某种障碍影响到儿童处理言语和口头交流信息的能力，他们就可能尤其容易受到噪声的伤害。

22.en: The attention deficit disorders are indicative of neurological and genetic disorders and are characterised by difficulties with sustaining attention, effort and persistence, organisation skills and disinhibition.
parts: 注意缺陷类障碍是神经和遗传方面异常的表现。
其特征包括难以持续集中注意、保持努力并坚持做事，组织能力较弱，也难以抑制冲动。

25.en: Children experiencing an auditory function deficit can often find speech and communication very difficult to isolate and process when set against high levels of background noise.
parts: 在背景噪声很强时，听觉功能有障碍的儿童往往很难单独辨别出言语和交流信息并加以处理。

32.en: The strategy recognises that people experiencing disability face significant barriers in achieving a full quality of life in areas such as attitude, education, employment and access to services.
parts: 这一战略承认，有障碍的人若要充分享有优质生活，面临着重重阻碍，
涉及社会态度、教育、就业和获取服务等方面。

33.en: Objective 3 of the New Zealand Disability Strategy is to ‘Provide the Best Education for Disabled People’ by improving education so that all children, youth learners and adult learners will have equal opportunities to learn and develop within their already existing local school.
parts: 《新西兰残障战略》的第三项目标是“为残障人士提供最好的教育”。
为此要改善教育，使所有儿童、青年和成人学习者都能在当地现有学校平等地获得学习和发展的机会。

34.en: For a successful education, the learning environment is vitally significant, so any effort to improve this is likely to be of great benefit to all children, but especially to those with auditory function disabilities.
parts: 学习环境对教育能否成功至关重要。因此，为改善环境所作的任何努力都很可能让所有儿童大为受益，
听觉功能有障碍的儿童尤其如此。

38.en: Only limited attention appears to have been given to those students experiencing the other disabilities involving auditory function deficit.
parts: 至于那些有其他障碍、且障碍涉及听觉功能的学生，他们受到的关注似乎相当有限。

27.en: “Although the image of the good worker is the one whose life belongs to the company,” Bailyn says, “it doesn’t fit the facts.”
parts: “人们心目中的好员工，整个人生都属于公司，”贝林说，“可这种形象与事实并不相符。”

28.en: She cites both quantitative and qualitative studies that show increased productivity for part-time workers: they make better use of the time they have and they are less likely to succumb to fatigue in stressful jobs.
parts: 她援引了定量和定性两类研究，这些研究都表明，兼职员工的工作效率有所提高。
他们更能充分利用工作时间，在压力大的岗位上也较少会因疲劳而撑不住。

29.en: Companies that employ more workers for less time also gain from the resulting redundancy, she asserts.
parts: 她断言，企业多雇一些员工，让每人少工作一些时间，还能从由此形成的人员余量中获益。

1.en: For the first century or so of the industrial revolution, increased productivity led to decreases in working hours.
parts: 在工业革命开始后大约一个世纪的时间里，生产率的提高带来了工作时间的缩短。

18.en: Diminishing returns may eventually set in as overworked employees lose efficiency or leave for more arable pastures.
parts: 员工工作过度，效率会下降，也有人会另谋更好的出路。这样一来，边际收益最终可能开始递减。

37.en: As Schor notes, the situation is a curious inversion of the “appropriate technology” vision that designers have had for developing countries: U.S. goods are appropriate only for high incomes and long hours.
parts: 正如肖尔所说，这种局面颇为奇特：它把设计者为发展中国家设想的“适用技术”理念颠倒了过来。
美国的商品只适合收入高、工作时间长的人。

10.en: Since 1979, companies have responded to improvements in the business climate by having employees work overtime rather than by hiring extra personnel, says economist Juliet B. Schor of Harvard University.
parts: 自1979年以来，商业环境好转时，企业的应对方式一直是让员工加班，而非增聘人手。
这是哈佛大学经济学家朱丽叶·B·肖尔的观察。

23.en: “People who work reduced hours pay a huge penalty in career terms,” Schor maintains.
parts: “缩短工作时间的人会在职业发展上付出很大的代价，”肖尔坚持认为。

25.en: [Lotte] Bailyn [of Massachusetts Institute of Technology] adds that many corporate managers find it difficult to measure the contribution of their underlings to a firm’s well-being, so they use the number of hours worked as a proxy for output.
parts: 麻省理工学院的洛特·贝林补充说，许多企业管理者觉得，很难衡量下属对企业良好经营所作的贡献，
于是就用工时来间接衡量产出。

33.en: It may take even more than changes in the financial and cultural structures of employment for workers successfully to trade increased productivity and money for leisure time, Schor contends.
parts: 肖尔认为，劳动者若想把更高的生产率和收入换成闲暇时间，光改变就业制度的经济结构和文化结构可能还不够。

7.en: In fact, working hours have increased noticeably since 1970 — perhaps because real wages have stagnated since that year.
parts: 事实上，从1970年起，工时明显延长了——这或许是因为实际工资从那一年起就停滞不前。

9.en: There are several reasons for lost leisure.
parts: 人们的闲暇时间减少，有好几个原因。

34.en: She says the U.S. market for goods has become skewed by the assumption of full-time, two-career households.
parts: 她说，美国商品市场出现了偏差，因为它把双方都全职工作的双职工家庭视为常态。

35.en: Automobile makers no longer manufacture cheap models, and developers do not build the tiny bungalows that served the first postwar generation of home buyers.
parts: 汽车制造商已经不再生产廉价车型，房地产开发商也不再建造那种曾满足战后第一代购房者需求的小平房。

31.en: The motion of a pendulum rocks this device so that it catches and then releases each tooth of the escape wheel, in turn allowing it to turn a precise amount.
parts: 钟摆的运动带动这一装置来回摆动，使它逐齿卡住擒纵轮的轮齿再放开，
从而使擒纵轮每次都恰好转过一定的角度。

1.en: Our conception of time depends on the way we measure it
parts: 我们怎样理解时间，取决于我们怎样衡量时间。

37.en: So integral have these time-based technologies become to day-to-day existence that our dependency on them is recognised only when they fail to work.
parts: 这些基于计时的技术与日常生活已经密不可分，以至于只有当它们失灵时，我们才意识到自己有多依赖它们。

2.en: According to archaeological evidence, at least 5,000 years ago, and long before the advent of the Roman Empire, the Babylonians began to measure time, introducing calendars to co-ordinate communal activities, to plan the shipment of goods and, in particular, to regulate planting and harvesting.
parts: 考古证据表明，至少在五千年前，远在罗马帝国出现之前，巴比伦人就开始计时了。
他们引入历法，以协调集体活动、安排货运，尤其是确定播种和收获的时间。

6.en: Hence, the calendars that were developed at the lower latitudes were influenced more by the lunar cycle than by the solar year.
parts: 因此，在较低纬度地区形成的历法受月相周期的影响，比受太阳年的影响更大。

9.en: Centuries before the Roman Empire, the Egyptians had formulated a municipal calendar having 12 months of 30 days, with five days added to approximate the solar year.
parts: 早在罗马帝国出现前几个世纪，埃及人就制定了民用历法：一年十二个月，每月三十天，另加五天，使一年的天数接近太阳年。

10.en: Each period of ten days was marked by the appearance of special groups of stars called decans.
parts: 每隔十天，就有一组特定的恒星出现，标志着新的一旬开始。这些星群称为“旬星”。

11.en: At the rise of the star Sirius just before sunrise, which occurred around the all-important annual flooding of the Nile, 12 decans could be seen spanning the heavens.
parts: 天狼星在日出前夕升起，这一现象大致出现在每年那场至关重要的尼罗河泛滥前后。
此时可以看到十二组旬星横跨天空。

12.en: The cosmic significance the Egyptians placed in the 12 decans led them to develop a system in which each interval of darkness （and later, each interval of daylight） was divided into a dozen equal parts.
parts: 埃及人赋予这十二组旬星以宇宙层面的意义，于是创立了一种计时制度：
每段黑夜都被等分为十二份，后来每段白昼也作同样的划分。

13.en: These periods became known as temporal hours because their duration varied according to the changing length of days and nights with the passing of the seasons.
parts: 这些计时单位被称为“不等时”，因为随着季节交替和昼夜长短的变化，每一时段的时长也会改变。

15.en: Temporal hours, which were first adopted by the Greeks and then the Romans, who disseminated them through Europe, remained in use for more than 2,500 years.
parts: 不等时制最初由希腊人采用，后来罗马人也采用了它，并将它传遍欧洲。这种计时方法沿用了两千五百多年。

16.en: In order to track temporal hours during the day, inventors created sundials, which indicate time by the length or direction of the sun’s shadow.
parts: 为在白天测定不等时，发明者制作了日晷，利用日影的长度或方向指示时间。

17.en: The sundial’s counterpart, the water clock, was designed to measure temporal hours at night.
parts: 与日晷相对应的是水钟，它是为在夜间测定不等时而设计的。

23.en: The schemes that divided the day into 24 equal parts varied according to the start of the count: Italian hours began at sunset, Babylonian hours at sunrise, astronomical hours at midday and ‘great clock’ hours, used for some large public clocks in Germany, at midnight.
parts: 一天都分为二十四等份，但各套制度的起算时刻不同：
意大利时从日落算起，巴比伦时从日出算起，天文时从正午算起，
而德国某些大型公共时钟采用的“大钟时”则从午夜算起。

26.en: The revolutionary aspect of this new timekeeper was neither the descending weight that provided its motive force nor the gear wheels （which had been around for at least 1,300 years） that transferred the power; it was the part called the escapement.
parts: 这种新计时器的革命性之处，既不在于提供动力的下落重锤，
也不在于传递动力的齿轮（齿轮当时至少已有一千三百年的历史），
而在于那个叫作“擒纵机构”的部件。

32.en: Unlike the original form used in early pendulum clocks, the anchor escapement permitted the pendulum to travel in a very small arc.
parts: 与早期摆钟采用的原始结构不同，锚式擒纵机构使钟摆得以沿很小的圆弧摆动。

35.en: Nearly all computers contain a quartz-crystal clock to regulate their operation.
parts: 几乎所有计算机都装有石英晶体时钟，用于调控计算机的运行。

36.en: Moreover, not only do time signals beamed down from Global Positioning System satellites calibrate the functions of precision navigation equipment, they do so as well for mobile phones, instant stock-trading systems and nationwide power-distribution grids.
parts: 此外，全球定位系统卫星向地面发射的时间信号，不仅用来校准精密导航设备，
也用来校准手机、即时股票交易系统和全国配电网络的运行。

14.en: Summer hours were long, winter ones short; only at the spring and autumn equinoxes were the hours of daylight and darkness equal.
parts: 白昼的一小时在夏季较长，冬季较短。只有在春分和秋分，白昼与黑夜的一小时才等长。

21.en: The advent of the mechanical clock meant that although it could be adjusted to maintain temporal hours, it was naturally suited to keeping equal ones.
parts: 机械钟问世后，虽然可以调整它来计不等时，但它本身更适合按等长的小时计时。

24.en: Eventually these were superseded by ‘small clock’, or French, hours, which split the day into two 12-hour periods commencing at midnight.
parts: 这些制度最终被“小钟时”（又称法国时制）取代。这种时制从午夜起算，把一天分为两个十二小时的时段。

33.en: Moreover, this invention allowed the use of a long pendulum which could beat once a second and thus led to the development of a new floor-standing case design, which became known as the grandfather clock.
parts: 此外，这项发明让人们可以使用每秒摆动一下的长摆，
也由此催生出一种采用落地式钟壳的新设计，后来人们称这种钟为“落地大摆钟”。

2.en: And yet most of us have had the experience of having to adjust to sleeping in the mountains or the countryside because it was initially ‘too quiet’, an experience that suggests that humans are capable of adapting to a wide range of noise levels.
parts: 可我们大多有过这样的经历：在山区或乡下睡觉，一开始觉得“太安静”，得花些时间适应。
这表明人能适应相差很大的噪声水平。

8.en: For example, high noise levels interfered with the performance of subjects who were required to monitor three dials at a time, a task not unlike that of an aeroplane pilot or an air-traffic controller (Broadbent, 1957).
parts: 例如，受试者需要同时监看三个仪表盘时，强噪声会影响他们的表现。
这项任务颇似飞行员或空中交通管制员的工作（布罗德本特，1957年）。

9.en: Similarly, noise did not affect a subject’s ability to track a moving line with a steering wheel, but it did interfere with the subject’s ability to repeat numbers while tracking (Finkelman and Glass, 1970).
parts: 同样，噪声并不影响受试者用方向盘追踪移动线条的能力，
但如果要一边追踪一边复述数字，噪声确实会干扰他们复述数字的能力（芬克尔曼和格拉斯，1970年）。

13.en: For some subjects, the bursts were spaced exactly one minute apart (predictable noise); others heard the same amount of noise overall, but the bursts occurred at random intervals (unpredictable noise).
parts: 有些受试者听到的一阵阵噪声恰好相隔一分钟（可预测噪声）。
另一些人听到的噪声总量相同，但各阵噪声之间的间隔是随机的（不可预测噪声）。

25.en: One study, suggesting that this worry is a realistic one, compared elementary school pupils who attended schools near Los Angeles’s busiest airport with students who attended schools in quiet neighbourhoods (Cohen et al., 1980).
parts: 一项研究表明，这种担忧确有根据。研究者比较了两组小学生：
一组在洛杉矶最繁忙的机场附近上学，另一组在安静的街区上学（科恩等，1980年）。

1.en: In general, it is plausible to suppose that we should prefer peace and quiet to noise.
parts: 一般说来，有理由认为，相比噪声，我们更喜欢平静安宁。

11.en: We are much more able to ‘tune out’ chronic background noise, even if it is quite loud, than to work under circumstances with unexpected intrusions of noise.
parts: 持续的背景噪声，即使相当响，我们也比较容易把它“屏蔽”掉。
相比之下，要在不时受到突发噪声干扰的环境中工作，就难得多了。

12.en: In the Glass and Singer study, in which subjects were exposed to bursts of noise as they worked on a task, some subjects heard loud bursts and others heard soft bursts.
parts: 在格拉斯和辛格的研究中，受试者在完成任务时听到一阵阵噪声。
有些人听到的噪声很响，有些人听到的则很轻。

20.en: If the individual knows that he or she can control the noise, this seems to eliminate both its negative effects at the time and its after-effects.
parts: 如果一个人知道自己能够控制噪声，那么，噪声当时的不利影响和事后的影响似乎都会消失。

26.en: It was found that children from the noisy schools had higher blood pressure and were more easily distracted than those who attended the quiet schools.
parts: 研究发现，与在安静学校上学的儿童相比，在嘈杂学校上学的儿童血压更高，也更容易分心。

7.en: The topics discussed included the co-ordinated study of the destruction of forests, as well as how to combat forest fires and the extension of European research programs on the forest ecosystem.
parts: 会上讨论的议题包括协同研究森林破坏问题，
也包括如何扑救森林火灾，以及扩大欧洲的森林生态系统研究计划。

15.en: Finally, they offer those condemned to spend five days a week in an urban environment an unrivalled area of freedom to unwind and take part in a range of leisure activities, such as hunting, riding and hiking.
parts: 最后，对那些每周有五天不得不待在城市里的人来说，森林提供了一处无可比拟的自由天地，
让他们放松身心，参加打猎、骑马、徒步等各种休闲活动。

21.en: This means that a forest policy is vital, that it must transcend national frontiers and generations of people, and that it must allow for the inevitable changes that take place in the forests, in needs, and hence in policy.
parts: 这意味着森林政策至关重要。它必须超越国界，跨越世代，
还必须考虑到森林本身和人们的需求不可避免地会改变，政策也因此会随之改变。

13.en: The first is to act as a ‘green lung’ for our planet; by means of photosynthesis, forests produce oxygen through the transformation of solar energy, thus fulfilling what for humans is the essential role of an immense, non-polluting power plant.
parts: 第一项作用是充当地球的“绿肺”。
森林通过光合作用转化太阳能，产生氧气。
这样，森林就像一座庞大而无污染的发电厂，发挥着对人类不可或缺的作用。

23.en: A general declaration was made that ‘a central place in any ecologically coherent forest policy must be given to continuity over time and to the possible effects of unforeseen events, to ensure that the full potential of these forests is maintained’.
parts: 会议发表了一项总声明，指出：“任何符合生态规律的森林政策，都必须把长期的连续性放在核心位置，
也必须同样重视意外事件可能产生的影响，以确保这些森林的全部潜力得以保持。”

37.en: A thinly scattered permanent population and development of leisure activities, particularly skiing, have resulted in significant long-term changes to the local ecosystems.
parts: 当地常住人口分布稀疏，休闲活动也有所发展，尤以滑雪为甚。
这两点使当地生态系统发生了显著而持久的变化。

3.en: European countries are becoming increasingly concerned by major threats to European forests, threats which know no frontiers other than those of geography or climate: air pollution, soil deterioration, the increasing number of forest fires and sometimes even the mismanagement of our woodland and forest heritage.
parts: 欧洲各国越来越担忧欧洲森林面临的重大威胁。
这些威胁只受地理或气候条件的限制：
空气污染、土壤退化、森林火灾日益增多，有时甚至还包括人们对林地与森林遗产管理不善。

16.en: The economic importance of forests has been understood since the dawn of man - wood was the first fuel.
parts: 自人类出现之初，人们就已认识到森林的经济价值——木材是人类最早使用的燃料。

27.en: The entire continent and the majority of species are now affected: between 30% and 50% of the tree population.
parts: 如今，全欧洲和大多数树种都受到波及，受影响的树木占总数的30%至50%。

46.en: Their final text commits them to on-going discussion between government representatives with responsibility for forests.
parts: 会议的最终文件要求与会各方作出承诺，让各国主管森林事务的政府代表持续开展对话。

3.en: ‘The glass industry is aware of the issue,’ says Brian Waldron, chairman of the standards committee at the Glass and Glazing Federation, a British trade association, and standards development officer at Pilkington.
parts: “玻璃行业知道这个问题，”布赖恩·沃尔德伦说。
他是英国行业协会玻璃与装配玻璃联合会标准委员会主席，同时也是皮尔金顿公司的标准制定专员。
terms: 玻璃与装配玻璃联合会

9.en: Researchers claim that the human personality is formed during the first two years of life, and during the first three years children learn the basic skills they will use in all their later learning both at home and at school.
parts: 研究人员认为，人的个性在出生后的头两年形成。
在头三年里，儿童会学到一些基本技能，此后无论在家还是在学校，学习时都会用到这些技能。
terms: both at home and at school
both at home and at school

5.en: The report argued for enhanced equity of access and better funding for childcare and early childhood education institutions.
parts: 报告主张，让人们有更公平的机会获得托育与幼儿教育服务，并为提供这些服务的机构改善经费保障。
terms: 获得服务机会的公平性

10.en: Once over the age of three, children continue to expand on existing knowledge of the world.
parts: 三岁以后，孩子们在已有认识的基础上，继续加深对世界的了解。

31.en: Parent resource centres, located in school buildings, offered learning materials for families and facilitators for child care.
parts: 设在校舍里的家长资源中心为家庭提供学习资料，还安排人员协助照看儿童。

7.en: A 13-year study of early childhood development at Harvard University has shown that, by the age of three, most children have the potential to understand about 1000 words – most of the language they will use in ordinary conversation for the rest of their lives.
parts: 哈佛大学一项历时13年的幼儿发展研究表明，到三岁时，大多数儿童就有能力理解约1000个词，
这些词占他们此后一生在日常交谈中所用词汇的大部分。
terms: for the rest of their lives
for the rest of their lives

23.en: The ‘Missouri’ programme was predicated on research showing that working with the family, rather than bypassing the parents, is the most effective way of helping children get off to the best possible start in life.
parts: “密苏里”项目所依据的研究表明，与家庭合作、让父母参与，是帮助孩子获得最佳人生起点的最有效方法。

24.en: The four-year pilot study included 380 families who were about to have their first child and who represented a cross-section of socio-economic status, age and family configurations.
parts: 这项为期四年的试点研究纳入了380个即将迎来第一个孩子的家庭，涵盖不同的社会经济状况、父母年龄和家庭结构。

27.en: Information on child development, and guidance on things to look for and expect as the child grows were provided, plus guidance in fostering the child’s intellectual, language, social and motor-skill development.
parts: 项目向家长介绍儿童发展知识，指导他们在孩子成长过程中留意哪些迹象、可以预期哪些变化，
还指导他们培养孩子的智力、语言能力、社交能力和运动技能。

30.en: Parent-educators made personal visits to homes and monthly group meetings were held with other new parents to share experience and discuss topics of interest.
parts: 家长教育辅导员会亲自上门家访，此外还每月组织新手父母聚会，让他们交流经验，讨论感兴趣的话题。

32.en: At the age of three, the children who had been involved in the “Missouri” programme were evaluated alongside a cross-section of children selected from the same range of socio-economic backgrounds and family situations, and also a random sample of children that age.
parts: 参加“密苏里”项目的儿童在三岁时接受了评估。
与他们一同接受评估的，一组是从相同范围的社会经济背景和家庭状况中选出的代表性儿童，另一组则是随机抽取的同龄儿童。

34.en: By the age of three, the children in the programme were significantly more advanced in language development than their peers, had made greater strides in problem solving and other intellectual skills, and were further along in social development.
parts: 到三岁时，参加项目的儿童在语言发展上已明显领先于同龄人，
在解决问题和其他智力技能上也取得了更大进步，社交能力的发展同样更为超前。

34.en: ‘Moreover, the loss of diversity may also deprive us of different ways of looking at the world,’ says Pagel.
parts: “而且，多样性的丧失还可能使我们失去从不同角度看待世界的机会，”佩格尔说。

45.en: The explanation for this seems to be that it is valuable to place people working in related fields together.
parts: 原因似乎在于，让从事相关领域工作的人聚集在一起很有价值。

46.en: ‘The new world will largely depend on human creativity, and creativity flourishes where people come together face-to-face.’
parts: “新世界将在很大程度上依赖人类的创造力，而创造力在人们面对面相聚时最为蓬勃。”

2.en: The study compared the proportion of wealth poured into transport by thirty-seven cities around the world.
parts: 这项研究比较了世界各地37座城市各自投入交通的资金占其财富的比例。

14.en: Newman, however, believes the study demonstrates that ‘the auto-dependent city model is inefficient and grossly inadequate in economic as well as environmental terms’.
parts: 纽曼则认为，研究表明，“依赖汽车的城市模式效率低下，而且从经济和环境两方面看都极不理想”。

15.en: Bicycle use was not included in the study but Newman noted that the two most ‘bicycle friendly’ cities considered - Amsterdam and Copenhagen - were very efficient, even though their public transport systems were ‘reasonable but not special’.
parts: 该研究没有把自行车出行纳入统计。但纽曼指出，在纳入考察的城市中，对骑自行车最友好的两座——阿姆斯特丹和哥本哈根——交通效率很高，
尽管它们的公共交通系统只算“尚可，没什么特别”。
terms: 阿姆斯特丹和哥本哈根

39.en: In cities that developed later, the World Bank and Asian Development Bank discouraged the building of public transport and people have been forced to rely on cars creating the massive traffic jams that characterize those cities.
parts: 在发展较晚的城市，世界银行和亚洲开发银行不鼓励建设公共交通。
人们被迫依赖汽车，造成了这些城市典型的严重交通拥堵。

16.en: It is common for supporters of road networks to reject the models of cities with good public transport by arguing that such systems would not work in their particular city.
parts: 支持发展道路网的人常常不接受公共交通发达城市的做法，理由是那样的交通系统在他们自己的城市行不通。

37.en: The Acoma and San Ildefonso pueblos have established highly profitable pottery businesses, while the Navajo and Hopi groups have been similarly successful with jewellery.
parts: 阿科马和圣伊尔德丰索两个普韦布洛社群建立了利润丰厚的制陶业，
纳瓦霍人和霍皮人经营珠宝首饰也同样成功。

11.en: The writer Arthur Koestler dubbed it the luxury reflex: ‘unique in that it serves no apparent biological purpose’.
parts: 作家阿瑟·库斯勒把笑称为“奢侈的反射”，认为它“独特之处在于，它没有明显的生物学用途”。

2.en: After years in the wilderness, the term ‘artificial intelligence’ (AI) seems poised to make a comeback.
parts: 沉寂多年之后，“人工智能”（AI）这个词似乎又要重新流行起来了。

4.en: Day length is an excellent cue, because it provides a perfectly predictable pattern of change within the year.
parts: 白昼的长短是个很好的信号，因为它在一年中的变化有完全可预测的规律。

2.en: The results of a 14-year study to be announced later this month reveal that the diseases associated with old age are afflicting fewer and fewer people and when they do strike, it is much later in life.
parts: 一项历时14年的研究将于本月晚些时候公布结果。结果显示，受老年相关疾病困扰的人越来越少，
即使发病，发病年龄也比过去晚得多。
terms: 在人生中晚得多的时候

4.en: Researchers, now analysing the results of data gathered in 1994, say arthritis, high blood pressure and circulation problems — the major medical complaints in this age group — are troubling a smaller proportion every year.
parts: 研究人员正在分析1994年收集的数据。他们说，关节炎、高血压和血液循环问题，
是这个年龄段最主要的健康问题。受这几种疾病困扰的人所占的比例逐年下降。

5.en: And the data confirms that the rate at which these diseases are declining continues to accelerate.
parts: 数据也证实，这些疾病在人群中所占的比例下降得越来越快。

6.en: Other diseases of old age - dementia, stroke, arteriosclerosis and emphysema - are also troubling fewer and fewer people.
parts: 痴呆、中风、动脉硬化和肺气肿等其他老年病，困扰的人也越来越少。

8.en: He says the problems doctors accepted as normal in a 65-year-old in 1982 are often not appearing until people are 70 or 75.
parts: 他说，1982年医生认为在65岁的人身上属正常的那些问题，现在往往要到70岁或75岁才出现。

9.en: Clearly, certain diseases are beating a retreat in the face of medical advances.
parts: 显然，随着医学进步，某些疾病正逐渐减少。

11.en: Improvements in childhood nutrition in the first quarter of the twentieth century, for example, gave today’s elderly people a better start in life than their predecessors.
parts: 例如，在20世纪头25年里，儿童营养的改善使今天这代老年人的人生起点好于前辈。

14.en: ‘These may be subtle influences,’ says Manton, ‘but our subjects have been exposed to worse and worse pollution for over 60 years.
parts: “这些因素的影响也许并不明显，”曼顿说，“但我们的研究对象在六十多年里一直暴露在日益严重的污染中。

15.en: It’s not surprising we see some effect.’
parts: 我们能看到一些影响，并不奇怪。”

16.en: One interesting correlation Manton uncovered is that better-educated people are likely to live longer.
parts: 曼顿发现了一项有意思的关联：受教育程度较高的人往往更长寿。

17.en: For example, 65-year-old women with fewer than eight years of schooling are expected, on average, to live to 82.
parts: 例如，受教育不足八年的65岁女性，预计平均能活到82岁。

19.en: Although some of this can be attributed to a higher income, Manton believes it is mainly because educated people seek more medical attention.
parts: 收入较高可以解释其中的一部分差异，但曼顿认为，主要原因是受过教育的人更常就医。

20.en: The survey also assessed how independent people over 65 were, and again found a striking trend.
parts: 调查还评估了65岁以上人群独立生活的程度，同样发现了一个引人注目的趋势。

21.en: Almost 80% of those in the 1994 survey could complete everyday activities ranging from eating and dressing unaided to complex tasks such as cooking and managing their finances.
parts: 在1994年的受访者中，近80%能完成各类日常活动，从自己吃饭、穿衣，
到做饭、理财这样较为复杂的事情。

22.en: That represents a significant drop in the number of disabled old people in the population.
parts: 这表明，人口中失能老年人的数量显著减少了。

23.en: If the trends apparent in the United States 14 years ago had continued, researchers calculate there would be an additional one million disabled elderly people in today’s population.
parts: 据研究人员推算，如果美国14年前显现的趋势延续至今，今天还会多出100万名失能老人。

24.en: According to Manton, slowing the trend has saved the United States government’s Medicare system more than $200 billion, suggesting that the greying of America’s population may prove less of a financial burden than expected.
parts: 曼顿说，这一趋势的放缓已为美国政府的联邦医疗保险计划节省了2000多亿美元。
这表明，美国人口老龄化带来的财政负担可能比预想的轻。
terms: 美国联邦医疗保险计划

25.en: The increasing self-reliance of many elderly people is probably linked to a massive increase in the use of simple home medical aids.
parts: 许多老年人越来越能自理，这可能与家用简易医疗辅助器具的使用大幅增加有关。

26.en: For instance, the use of raised toilet seats has more than doubled since the start of the study, and the use of bath seats has grown by more than 50%.
parts: 例如，跟研究刚开始时相比，加高马桶座圈的使用量已超过原来的两倍，洗澡椅的使用量则增加了50%以上。

29.en: Maintaining a level of daily physical activity may help mental functioning, says Carl Cotman, a neuroscientist at the University of California at Irvine.
parts: 加州大学欧文分校的神经科学家卡尔·科特曼说，每天保持一定的体力活动，可能有益于心智功能。

30.en: He found that rats that exercise on a treadmill have raised levels of brain-derived neurotrophic factor coursing through their brains.
parts: 他发现，在跑步机上运动的大鼠，脑内流动的脑源性神经营养因子水平较高。

37.en: The research suggests that older people fare best when they feel independent but know they can get help when they need it.
parts: 研究表明，老年人如果觉得自己能独立生活，同时知道需要时有人帮忙，状态就最好。

38.en: ‘Like much research into ageing, these results support common sense,’ says Seeman.
parts: 塞曼说：“这与许多有关老龄化的研究一样，研究结果印证了常识。”

40.en: ‘The sort of thing that your grandmother always told you turns out to be right on target,’ she says.
parts: 她说：“你祖母常跟你讲的那些道理，到头来还真说对了。”

3.en: Inuit families going off on snowmobiles to prepare their summer hunting camps have found themselves cut off from home by a sea of mud, following early thaws.
parts: 有些因纽特家庭骑雪地摩托出去准备夏季狩猎营地，却发现冰雪提早消融，遍地泥泞，回家的路被阻断了。

5.en: Climate change may still be a rather abstract idea to most of us, but in the Arctic it is already having dramatic effects — if summertime ice continues to shrink at its present rate, the Arctic Ocean could soon become virtually ice-free in summer.
parts: 对我们大多数人来说，气候变化可能仍是个相当抽象的概念，但它已给北极带来显著影响。
如果夏季海冰继续以目前的速度消退，北冰洋或许很快就会在夏天几乎没有海冰。

7.en: Scientists are increasingly keen to find out what’s going on because they consider the Arctic the ‘canary in the mine’ for global warming — a warning of what’s in store for the rest of the world.
parts: 科学家们越来越想弄清楚北极正在发生什么，因为他们把北极看作全球变暖的“矿井里的金丝雀”，
它预示着世界其他地方将会面临什么。

16.en: Farming is out of the question and nature offers meagre pickings.
parts: 这里根本无法耕作，大自然所能提供的食物也少得可怜。

17.en: Humans first settled in the Arctic a mere 4,500 years ago, surviving by exploiting sea mammals and fish.
parts: 人类直到4500年前才首次在北极定居，靠捕猎海洋哺乳动物和捕鱼为生。

20.en: These Thule people moved in from Alaska, bringing kayaks, sleds, dogs, pottery and iron tools.
parts: 这些图勒人从阿拉斯加迁来，带来了皮艇、雪橇、狗、陶器和铁制工具。

22.en: Life for the descendants of the Thule people is still harsh.
parts: 图勒人的后代至今仍过着艰苦的生活。

24.en: It’s currently home to 2,500 people, all but a handful of them indigenous Inuit.
parts: 这里当时住着2500人，除少数人外，都是当地原住的因纽特人。

25.en: Over the past 40 years, most have abandoned their nomadic ways and settled in the territory’s 28 isolated communities, but they still rely heavily on nature to provide food and clothing.
parts: 过去40年间，大多数因纽特人放弃了游居生活，在这块领地上28个偏远的社区定居，
但他们所需的食物和衣物仍在很大程度上取自大自然。

27.en: It would cost a family around £7,000 a year to replace meat they obtained themselves through hunting with imported meat.
parts: 一家人如果把自家打猎所得的肉换成进口肉，一年大约得花7000英镑。

29.en: While the Inuit may not actually starve if hunting and trapping are curtailed by climate change, there has certainly been an impact on people’s health.
parts: 即使气候变化限制了狩猎和设陷捕猎，因纽特人也未必真会挨饿，
但人们的健康确实已经受到了影响。

31.en: There has been a crisis of identity as the traditional skills of hunting, trapping and preparing skins have begun to disappear.
parts: 狩猎、设陷捕猎和处理兽皮的传统技艺开始消失，因纽特人也因此面临身份认同危机。

32.en: In Nunavut’s ‘igloo and email’ society, where adults who were born in igloos have children who may never have been out on the land, there’s a high incidence of depression.
parts: 在努纳武特这个“冰屋与电子邮件并存”的社会里，有的父母出生在冰屋中，而子女可能从未到过野外。这里的抑郁症发病率很高。

33.en: With so much at stake, the Inuit are determined to play a key role in teasing out the mysteries of climate change in the Arctic.
parts: 这件事关系重大。因纽特人决心在解开北极气候变化之谜的过程中发挥关键作用。

35.en: And Western scientists are starting to draw on this wisdom, increasingly referred to as ‘Inuit Qaujimajatuqangit’, or IQ.
parts: 西方科学家也开始借鉴这种智慧。人们越来越常用因纽特语名称 Inuit Qaujimajatuqangit 来称呼它，简称 IQ。
terms: 因纽特传统知识的简称

36.en: ‘In the early days scientists ignored us when they came up here to study anything.
parts: “早些年，科学家到这儿来，不管研究什么都不理会我们。

37.en: They just figured these people don’t know very much so we won’t ask them,’ says John Amagoalik, an Inuit leader and politician.
parts: 他们就是觉得，‘这些人懂得不多，我们就不问他们了。’”因纽特人领袖、政治家约翰·阿马戈阿利克说。

38.en: ‘But in recent years IQ has had much more credibility and weight.’
parts: “不过，近几年，因纽特传统知识的可信度和影响力都提高了许多。”
terms: 因纽特传统知识的简称

39.en: In fact it is now a requirement for anyone hoping to get permission to do research that they consult the communities, who are helping to set the research agenda to reflect their most important concerns.
parts: 事实上，如今任何人要取得研究许可，都必须先征询当地社区的意见。
这些社区正参与制定研究议程，让它体现自己最关心的问题。

40.en: They can turn down applications from scientists they believe will work against their interests, or research projects that will impinge too much on their daily lives and traditional activities.
parts: 如果社区认为某位科学家的工作会损害本社区的利益，便可拒绝其申请。对日常生活和传统活动干扰过多的研究项目，社区也可以拒绝。

43.en: There are still huge gaps in our environmental knowledge, and despite the scientific onslaught, many predictions are no more than best guesses.
parts: 我们对环境的认识还有很大空白。尽管科学研究在大力推进，许多预测也不过是根据现有信息作出的推测。
terms: 据现有信息所作的推测

44.en: IQ could help to bridge the gap and resolve the tremendous uncertainty about how much of what we’re seeing is natural capriciousness and how much is the consequence of human activity.
parts: 因纽特人的传统知识或许能帮助填补这一空白，解开一个至今很难说准的问题：
我们所看到的变化，有多少出自自然本身的变幻，又有多少是人类活动造成的？
terms: 因纽特传统知识的简称

4.en: There are reports of igloos losing their insulating properties as the snow drips and refreezes, of lakes draining into the sea as permafrost melts, and sea ice breaking up earlier than usual, carrying seals beyond the reach of hunters.
parts: 有消息说，积雪融化滴落后又结冰，冰屋因此失去了隔热性能，
永久冻土融化，湖水由此流入海里，
海冰也比往年更早破裂，载着海豹漂到了猎人够不到的地方。

12.en: In Canada, where the Inuit people are jealously guarding their hard-won autonomy in the country’s newest territory, Nunavut, they believe their best hope of survival in this changing environment lies in combining their ancestral knowledge with the best of modern science.
parts: 在加拿大，因纽特人悉心守护着他们在该国新设的努纳武特地区争得的自治权。
他们相信，要在变化中的环境里生存，最大的希望在于把祖传知识与现代科学的精华结合起来。

18.en: The environment tested them to the limits: sometimes the colonists were successful, sometimes they failed and vanished.
parts: 环境给了他们最严峻的考验。有些定居者成功立足，有些没能生存下去，最终销声匿迹。

23.en: Nunavut is 1.9 million square kilometres of rock and ice, and a handful of islands around the North Pole.
parts: 努纳武特有190万平方公里的岩石和冰原，还包括北极点附近的几座岛屿。

30.en: Obesity, heart disease and diabetes are beginning to appear in a people for whom these have never before been problems.
parts: 肥胖、心脏病和糖尿病正开始出现在因纽特人当中，这些疾病过去从未困扰过这个民族。

1.en: The Lumiere Brothers opened their Cinematographe, at 14 Boulevard des Capucines in Paris, to 100 paying customers over 100 years ago, on December 8, 1895.
parts: 一百多年前，1895年12月8日，卢米埃尔兄弟在巴黎卡普西纳大道14号，向100名购票观众公开展示了他们的电影放映机。
terms: 卢米埃尔兄弟的电影机

2.en: Before the eyes of the stunned, thrilled audience, photographs came to life and moved across a flat screen.
parts: 在惊愕又兴奋的观众眼前，照片活了起来，画面在平平的银幕上动了起来。

3.en: So ordinary and routine has this become to us that it takes a determined leap of the imagination to grasp the impact of those first moving images.
parts: 活动影像对我们来说早已司空见惯，要体会最初那些影像给人带来的震撼，得着实发挥一番想象力。

4.en: But it is worth trying, for to understand the initial shock of those images is to understand the extraordinary power and magic of cinema, the unique, hypnotic quality that has made film the most dynamic, effective art form of the 20th century.
parts: 但这值得一试。因为要了解那些影像最初给人的震撼，就是要了解电影非凡的力量和魔力，
正是这种独有的、令人着迷的特质，使电影成为20世纪最有活力、最能打动人的艺术形式。

9.en: ‘As the train approached,’ wrote Tarkovsky, ‘panic started in the theatre: people jumped and ran away.
parts: “火车驶近时，”塔可夫斯基写道，“影院里顿时一片惊慌：人们跳起来跑开了。

13.en: In their confusion, they feared that a real train was about to crush them.’
parts: 他们一时分不清真假，害怕一列真的火车就要从自己身上碾过去了。”

15.en: In time, the idea of film became familiar, the magic was accepted – but it never stopped being magic.
parts: 后来，人们渐渐熟悉了电影，也接受了它的魔力，但那种魔力却从未消失。

16.en: Film has never lost its unique power to embrace its audiences and transport them to a different world.
parts: 电影从未失去它独有的力量，能把观众吸引进去，把他们带到另一个世界。

17.en: For Tarkovsky, the key to that magic was the way in which cinema created a dynamic image of the real flow of events.
parts: 在塔可夫斯基看来，电影的魔力就在于，它用活动影像呈现了事件实际展开的过程。

18.en: A still picture could only imply the existence of time, while time in a novel passed at the whim of the reader.
parts: 一幅静止的画面只能暗示时间的存在，小说里时间怎样流逝则随读者的心意而定。

23.en: Overwhelmingly, the lives recorded - at least in film fiction - have been American.
parts: 至少在虚构影片中，银幕记录的生活绝大多数是美国人的生活。

25.en: American imagery - the cars, the cities, the cowboys - became the primary imagery of film.
parts: 美国意象——汽车、城市、牛仔——成了电影里最主要的意象。

27.en: And, thanks to film, future generations will know the 20th century more intimately than any other period.
parts: 而且，多亏有了电影，后人对20世纪的了解会比对其他任何时期的了解都更为深入。

33.en: Film personalities have such an immediate presence that, inevitably, they become super-real.
parts: 电影明星给人的在场感如此直接，以至于他们难免显得比现实中的人还要真切。

35.en: The star as magnified human self is one of cinema’s most strange and enduring legacies.
parts: 明星是被放大了的人类自我形象，这是电影留给我们最奇特、最持久的遗产之一。

38.en: All that mattered at first was the wonder of movement.
parts: 起初，唯一要紧的就是画面能动起来所带来的惊奇。

41.en: Cinema might, for example, have become primarily a documentary form.
parts: 比如，电影原本可能主要发展为一种纪实形式。

42.en: Or it might have developed like television - as a strange, noisy transfer of music, information and narrative.
parts: 电影也可能走上电视那样的道路，成为一种奇特而喧闹的传播手段，用来传递音乐、信息和故事。

43.en: But what happened was that it became, overwhelmingly, a medium for telling stories.
parts: 但事实是，电影绝大部分时候成了讲故事的媒介。

44.en: Originally these were conceived as short stories - early producers doubted the ability of audiences to concentrate for more than the length of a reel.
parts: 最初，人们设想的是讲短故事。早期制片人怀疑，观众能否把注意力集中到超过一卷胶片放映时间那么久。

47.en: Almost unbelievably, it is a mere 100 years since that train arrived and the audience screamed and fled, convinced by the dangerous reality of what they saw, and, perhaps, suddenly aware that the world could never be the same again - that, maybe, it could be better, brighter, more astonishing, more real than reality.
parts: 几乎令人难以置信，离那列火车进站、观众尖叫着逃开的那一刻才不过一百年。当时他们确信，眼前的危险是真实的，
也许还突然意识到，世界再也不会和从前一样了。它或许会变得更好、更光明、更令人惊叹，甚至比现实还要真实。

10.en: That was the moment when cinema was born.
parts: 电影正是在那一刻诞生的。

26.en: Film carried American life and values around the globe.
parts: 电影把美国人的生活方式和价值观传遍了世界。

13.en: This year the survey shows a doubling of the number of women serving as non-executive directors compared with the previous year.
parts: 今年的调查显示，担任非执行董事的女性人数比上一年翻了一番。

12.en: Managerial and executive progress made by women is confirmed by the annual survey of boards of directors carried out by Korn/Ferry/Carre/Orban International.
parts: 科恩－费里－卡雷－奥尔班国际公司对董事会开展的年度调查，证实了女性在管理层和高管岗位上取得的进展。

6.en: The collections of the Department of Ethnography include approximately 300,000 artefacts, of which about half are the product of the present century.
parts: 民族志部约有30万件藏品，其中约一半制作于作者所处的20世纪。

20.en: Thus in OECD countries as a whole, health costs increased from 3.8% of GDP in 1960 to 7% of GDP in 1980, and it has been predicted that the proportion of health costs to GDP will continue to increase.
parts: 因此，就经合组织国家整体而言，医疗支出占国内生产总值的比重从1960年的3.8%升至1980年的7%。
据预测，医疗支出占国内生产总值的比重还会继续上升。

10.en: Daniel Jean Stanley of the Smithsonian Institute noticed that water samples taken in Cairo, just before the river enters the delta, indicated that the river sometimes carries more than 850 grams of sediment per cubic metre of water - almost half of what it carried before the dams were built.
parts: 史密森学会的丹尼尔·让·斯坦利注意到，在开罗、也就是河水即将流入三角洲的地方取得的水样表明，
有时每立方米河水携带的泥沙超过850克，接近建坝前含沙量的一半。

20.en: ‘Pollutants are building up faster and faster,’ says Stanley.
parts: 斯坦利说：“污染物正以越来越快的速度积聚。”

21.en: Based on his investigations of sediment from the delta lagoons, Frederic Siegel of George Washington University concurs.
parts: 乔治·华盛顿大学的弗雷德里克·西格尔根据自己对三角洲潟湖沉积物的研究，也认同这一看法。

22.en: ‘In Manzalah Lagoon, for example, the increase in mercury, lead, copper and zinc coincided with the building of the High Dam at Aswan, the availability of cheap electricity, and the development of major power-based industries,’ he says.
parts: 他说：“例如，曼扎拉潟湖里的汞、铅、铜和锌都增加了，
这恰好与阿斯旺高坝的修建、廉价电力的供应以及大型耗电工业的发展发生在同一时期。”

23.en: Since that time the concentration of mercury has increased significantly.
parts: 从那时起，汞的浓度大幅上升。

6.en: By 1985, about 300,000 illiterate adults from all over the country, many of whom had never attended primary school, had learnt how to read, write and use numbers.
parts: 到1985年，全国各地已有约30万名不识字的成年人学会了读写和算数，他们中许多人从未上过小学。

7.en: During this period, researchers from the Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine, the Central American Institute of Health in Nicaragua, the National Autonomous University of Nicaragua and the Costa Rican Institute of Health interviewed nearly 3,000 women: some of whom had learnt to read as children, some during the literacy crusade and some who had never learnt at all.
parts: 在这一时期，来自利物浦热带医学院、尼加拉瓜的中美洲卫生研究所、尼加拉瓜国立自治大学和哥斯达黎加卫生研究所的研究者，
访谈了近3000名女性。有的儿童时期就学会了阅读，有的是在扫盲运动中学会的，还有的从未学会阅读。

24.en: ‘We’ve known for a long time that maternal education is important,’ says John Cleland of the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine.
parts: “我们早就知道，母亲接受教育很重要。”伦敦卫生与热带医学院的约翰·克莱兰说。

25.en: ‘But we thought that even if we started educating girls today, we’d have to wait a generation for the pay-off.
parts: “但我们原以为，就算今天开始让女孩接受教育，也得等上一代人才能见到成效。

26.en: The Nicaraguan study suggests we may be able to bypass that.’
parts: 尼加拉瓜的这项研究表明，也许我们可以省去这段等待。”

28.en: It is notoriously difficult to teach adults skills that do not have an immediate impact on their everyday lives, and many literacy campaigns in other countries have been much less successful.
parts: 众所周知，要让成年人学会短期内对日常生活没有直接影响的技能十分困难，其他国家的许多扫盲运动成效也差得多。

2.en: Experts in public health accepted this idea decades ago, but until now no one has been able to show that a woman’s ability to read in itself improves her children’s chances of survival.
parts: 公共卫生专家几十年前就接受了这个观点。不过，直到这项研究之前，还没人能证明母亲识字本身能提高子女的存活机会。

3.en: Most literate women learnt to read in primary school, and the fact that a woman has had an education may simply indicate her family’s wealth or that it values its children more highly.
parts: 多数识字女性是在小学学会阅读的。女性受过教育这一事实，可能仅仅说明她家境较好，或是她的家人更看重孩子。

4.en: Now a long-term study carried out in Nicaragua has eliminated these factors by showing that teaching reading to poor adult women, who would otherwise have remained illiterate, has a direct effect on their children’s health and survival.
parts: 尼加拉瓜的一项长期研究排除了这些因素的影响。研究表明，教那些原本会一直不识字的贫困成年女性阅读，
会直接影响她们孩子的健康和生存。

12.en: At this point in their lives, those mothers who later went on to learn to read had a similar level of child mortality (105/1000).
parts: 在当时，那些后来才学会阅读的母亲，其子女的死亡率也相近，为千分之105。
terms: At this point in their lives
at this point in their lives

13.en: For women educated in primary school, however, the infant mortality rate was significantly lower, at 80 per thousand.
parts: 相比之下，上过小学的母亲所生子女的婴儿死亡率显著较低，为每千名活产婴儿死亡80例。

14.en: In 1985, after the National Literacy Crusade had ended, the infant mortality figures for those who remained illiterate and for those educated in primary school remained more or less unchanged.
parts: 到1985年全国扫盲运动结束后，仍不识字的母亲和上过小学的母亲，其子女的婴儿死亡率都大致和先前一样。

15.en: For those women who learnt to read through the campaign, the infant mortality rate was 84 per thousand, an impressive 21 points lower than for those women who were still illiterate.
parts: 通过扫盲运动学会阅读的母亲，其子女的婴儿死亡率为千分之84，比仍不识字的母亲低了整整21个千分点。

20.en: They are working with the same group of 3,000 women, to try to find out whether reading mothers make better use of hospitals and clinics, opt for smaller families, exert more control at home, learn modern childcare techniques more quickly, or whether they merely have more respect for themselves and their children.
parts: 研究者仍在研究同一组3000名女性。他们想弄清楚，识字的母亲是否更善于利用医院和诊所，是否选择少生孩子、在家更有决定权，
是否能更快学会现代育儿方法，还是仅仅更尊重自己和孩子。

22.en: Sandiford says that there is increasing evidence that female education, at any age, is ‘an important health intervention in its own right’.
parts: 桑迪福德说，越来越多的证据表明，女性不论在哪个年龄接受教育，这本身都是“一项重要的健康干预”。

16.en: The children of the newly-literate mothers were also better nourished than those of women who could not read.
parts: 刚学会读写的母亲，她们的孩子营养状况也比不识字母亲的孩子好。

18.en: According to Peter Sandiford of the Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine, no one knows for certain.
parts: 利物浦热带医学院的彼得·桑迪福德表示，目前还没有人能给出确切答案。

19.en: Child health was not on the curriculum during the women’s lessons, so he and his colleagues are looking at other factors.
parts: 这些女性上课时并没有学过儿童健康知识，所以桑迪福德和同事们正在考察其他因素。

29.en: ‘The crusade was part of a larger effort to bring a better life to the people,’ says Cleland.
parts: 克莱兰说：“这场扫盲运动是一项更大行动的一部分，目的是让人们过上更好的生活。”

30.en: Replicating these conditions in other countries will be a major challenge for development workers.
parts: 对从事发展项目的人来说，要在其他国家重现这些条件，将是一项重大挑战。

1.en: For more than forty years the cost of food has been rising.
parts: 四十多年来，食物的成本一直在上升。

2.en: It has now reached a point where a growing number of people believe that it is far too high, and that bringing it down will be one of the great challenges of the twenty first century.
parts: 如今，这一成本已高到这样的地步：越来越多的人认为它实在太高，降低它将是21世纪的一大挑战。

3.en: That cost, however, is not in immediate cash.
parts: 不过，这里说的成本并不体现为当场支付的现金。

5.en: The cost is in the collateral damage of the very methods of food production that have made the food cheaper: in the pollution of water, the enervation of soil, the destruction of wildlife, the harm to animal welfare and the threat to human health caused by modern industrial agriculture.
parts: 恰恰是让食物变便宜的那些生产方式造成了附带损害，成本就体现在这些损害之中。
现代工业化农业污染了水源，削弱了土壤肥力，破坏了野生生物，还损害动物福利，威胁人类健康。

6.en: First mechanisation, then mass use of chemical fertilisers and pesticides, then monocultures, then battery rearing of livestock, and now genetic engineering - the onward march of intensive farming has seemed unstoppable in the last half-century, as the yields of produce have soared.
parts: 从最初的机械化，到大量使用化肥和农药，再到单一种植、密集圈养牲畜，直至如今的基因工程，
过去半个世纪里，随着农产品产量猛增，集约化农业的发展势头似乎无可阻挡。

8.en: In Britain, for example, many of our best-loved farmland birds, such as the skylark, the grey partridge, the lapwing and the corn bunting, have vanished from huge stretches of countryside, as have even more wild flowers and insects.
parts: 例如在英国，许多深受喜爱的农田鸟类，如云雀、灰山鹑、凤头麦鸡和黍鹀，
已从大片乡野消失。消失的野花和昆虫还要更多。

11.en: The faecal filth of salmon farming has driven wild salmon from many of the sea lochs and rivers of Scotland.
parts: 养殖鲑鱼产生的粪便污染，已把野生鲑鱼赶出了苏格兰的许多海湾和河流。

12.en: Natural soil fertility is dropping in many areas because of continuous industrial fertiliser and pesticide use, while the growth of algae is increasing in lakes because of the fertiliser run-off.
parts: 持续施用工业化生产的肥料和农药，使许多地区土壤的天然肥力下降。
与此同时，随地表径流流入湖泊的肥料使藻类长得更旺。

13.en: Put it all together and it looks like a battlefield, but consumers rarely make the connection at the dinner table.
parts: 把这些损害放在一起看，眼前简直像一片战场。可是坐到餐桌旁，消费者很少会把两者联系起来。
terms: 把这些情况放在一起看

14.en: That is mainly because the costs of all this damage are what economists refer to as externalities: they are outside the main transaction, which is for example producing and selling a field of wheat, and are borne directly by neither producers nor consumers.
parts: 这主要是因为，经济学家把所有这些损害造成的成本称为“外部性”。
它们游离于主要交易之外，例如一块田里小麦的生产和销售，既不由生产者直接承担，也不由消费者直接承担。

16.en: And anyway they, as consumers of food, certainly aren’t paying for it, are they?
parts: 再说，作为食品消费者，他们当然没有为这些损害付钱，对吗？

18.en: A remarkable exercise in doing this has been carried out by one of the world’s leading thinkers on the future of agriculture, Professor Jules Pretty, Director of the Centre for Environment and Society at the University of Essex.
parts: 在量化这些成本方面，朱尔斯·普雷蒂教授作了一次出色的尝试。他是研究农业未来的世界顶尖学者之一，
担任埃塞克斯大学环境与社会中心主任。

20.en: They added up the costs of repairing the damage it caused, and came up with a total figure of £2,343m.
parts: 他们把修复英国农业所造成损害的各项费用相加，得出的总数是23.43亿英镑。

21.en: This is equivalent to £208 for every hectare of arable land and permanent pasture, almost as much again as the total government and EU spend on British farming in that year.
parts: 折合下来，每公顷耕地和永久牧场要承担208英镑的外部成本。
这些额外成本的总额，几乎抵得上同年英国政府和欧盟在英国农业上的全部支出。
terms: 额外的数额几乎相当于

23.en: The costs included: £120m for removal of pesticides; £16m for removal of nitrates; £55m for removal of phosphates and soil; £23m for the removal of the bug cryptosporidium from drinking water by water companies; £125m for damage to wildlife habitats, hedgerows and dry stone walls; £1,113m from emissions of gases likely to contribute to climate change; £106m from soil erosion and organic carbon losses; £169m from food poisoning; and £607m from cattle disease.
parts: 这些成本包括清除农药的1.2亿英镑、清除硝酸盐的1600万英镑、清除磷酸盐和泥土的5500万英镑，
水务公司清除饮用水中隐孢子虫的2300万英镑，以及野生生物栖息地、树篱和干砌石墙受损造成的1.25亿英镑。
还包括排放可能导致气候变化的气体造成的11.13亿英镑，以及土壤侵蚀和有机碳流失造成的1.06亿英镑，
食物中毒造成的1.69亿英镑，以及牛患病造成的6.07亿英镑。

24.en: Professor Pretty draws a simple but memorable conclusion from all this: our food bills are actually threefold.
parts: 普雷蒂教授由此得出一个简单却令人难忘的结论：实际上，我们为食物付了三笔账。

27.en: Breaking away from industrial agriculture as the solution to hunger may be very hard for some countries, but in Britain, where the immediate need to supply food is less urgent, and the costs and the damage of intensive farming have been clearly seen, it may be more feasible.
parts: 对有些国家来说，要放弃依靠工业化农业解决饥饿问题，可能很难。
但在英国，保障眼下的食物供应没那么紧迫，人们也已经看清了集约化农业带来的成本和损害，因此这样做或许可行得多。

31.en: Furthermore, the price premium would put the produce out of reach of many poorer consumers.
parts: 此外，有机农产品价格较高，许多收入较低的消费者会买不起。

33.en: Such a standard would comprise agreed practices for different kinds of farming, covering agrochemical use, soil health, land management, water and energy use, food safety and animal health.
parts: 这项标准将包括各类农业生产中经各方商定的做法，
涉及农用化学品的使用、土壤健康、土地管理、水和能源的使用、食品安全和动物健康。

2.en: Marcus Chown reckons the answer could be ‘hanging in the air’.
parts: 马库斯·乔恩认为，答案也许就“悬在空中”。
terms: 悬在空中，也有悬而未决之意

4.en: The conventional picture is that tens of thousands of slaves dragged stones on sledges.
parts: 传统说法是，数以万计的奴隶用橇拖运石块。

6.en: Now a Californian software consultant called Maureen Clemmons has suggested that kites might have been involved.
parts: 如今，加利福尼亚州一位名叫莫琳·克莱蒙斯的软件顾问提出，当时可能用到了风筝。

12.en: ‘Coming from Iran, I have a keen interest in Middle Eastern science,’ he says.
parts: “我来自伊朗，一直对中东的科学很感兴趣，”他说。

14.en: The object in the sky apparently had wings far too short and wide for a bird.
parts: 天空中的那个物体看上去有翅膀，但就鸟的翅膀而言，显然太短，也太宽了。

15.en: ‘The possibility certainly existed that it was a kite,’ he says.
parts: 他说：“那确实可能是一只风筝。”

16.en: And since he needed a summer project for his student Emilio Graff, investigating the possibility of using kites as heavy lifters seemed like a good idea.
parts: 加里布正好要给学生埃米利奥·格拉夫找一个暑期研究项目。
研究一下能否用风筝吊起重物，看来是个好主意。

17.en: Gharib and Graff set themselves the task of raising a 4.5-metre stone column from horizontal to vertical, using no source of energy except the wind.
parts: 加里布和格拉夫给自己定下了一个任务：只靠风力，把一根4.5米长、平放着的石柱竖起来。

18.en: Their initial calculations and scale-model wind-tunnel experiments convinced them they wouldn’t need a strong wind to lift the 33.5-tonne column.
parts: 初步计算和缩尺模型风洞实验使他们确信，吊起这根33.5吨重的石柱并不需要强风。

22.en: The idea was that as one end of the column rose, the base would roll across the ground on a trolley.
parts: 他们的设想是，石柱一端升起时，底端会靠一辆小车沿地面滚动。

23.en: Earlier this year, the team put Clemmons’s unlikely theory to the test, using a 40-square-metre rectangular nylon sail.
parts: 当年早些时候，研究团队用一面40平方米的长方形尼龙帆，检验了克莱蒙斯这个看似不大可能成立的设想。
terms: 看似不大可能成立的假说

parts: 加里布说：“我们简直惊呆了。”

26.en: ‘The instant the sail opened into the wind, a huge force was generated and the column was raised to the vertical in a mere 40 seconds.’
parts: “帆一迎风张开，就产生了一股巨大的力，只用了40秒就把石柱竖了起来。”

27.en: The wind was blowing at a gentle 16 to 20 kilometres an hour, little more than half what they thought would be needed.
parts: 当时吹着每小时16至20公里的微风，风速只比他们原先以为需要的一半略高一点。

29.en: ‘There was a huge initial force – five times larger than the steady state force,’ Gharib says.
parts: 加里布说：“起初有一股巨大的力，是稳态下作用力的五倍。”

31.en: Even a 300-tonne column could have been lifted to the vertical with 40 or so men and four or five sails.
parts: 哪怕是300吨重的石柱，当时也可能只用约40个人和四五面帆就能将它竖起来。

32.en: So Clemmons was right: the pyramid builders could have used kites to lift massive stones into place.
parts: 这样看来，克莱蒙斯的设想有道理：金字塔建造者当时确有可能用风筝把巨石吊到所需的位置。

33.en: ‘Whether they actually did is another matter,’ Gharib says.
parts: 加里布说：“他们实际上是否这样做过，就是另一回事了。”

35.en: ‘The evidence for using kites to move large stones is no better or worse than the evidence for the brute force method,’ Gharib says.
parts: 加里布说：“用风筝搬运巨石的说法与靠蛮力搬运的说法相比，证据既不更强，也不更弱。”

37.en: ‘The evidence for kite-lifting is non-existent,’ says Willeke Wendrich, an associate professor of Egyptology at the University of California, Los Angeles.
parts: 加州大学洛杉矶分校的埃及学副教授威勒克·温德里希说：“没有证据表明古埃及人曾用风筝吊起重物。”

40.en: And they are known to have used wooden pulleys, which could have been made strong enough to bear the weight of massive blocks of stone.
parts: 我们知道，古埃及人用过木制滑轮，而且他们有可能造出足够结实的滑轮，来承受巨大石块的重量。

41.en: In addition, there is some physical evidence that the ancient Egyptians were interested in flight.
parts: 此外，还有一些实物证据表明，古埃及人对飞行感兴趣。

43.en: Although it dates from several hundred years after the building of the pyramids, its sophistication suggests that the Egyptians might have been developing ideas of flight for a long time.
parts: 这件文物的年代虽然比金字塔的建造晚了几百年，但它的精巧程度表明，古埃及人可能早已开始探索飞行。

47.en: Gharib has already been contacted by a civil engineer in Nicaragua, who wants to put up buildings with adobe roofs supported by concrete arches on a site that heavy equipment can’t reach.
parts: 尼加拉瓜的一位土木工程师已经联系了加里布。
他想在重型设备到不了的地方盖房子，屋顶用土坯做成，由混凝土拱支撑。

49.en: ‘We’ve given him some design hints,’ says Gharib.
parts: “我们已经给他提了一些设计上的建议，”加里布说。

50.en: ‘We’re just waiting for him to report back.’
parts: “现在我们就等着他反馈情况。”

13.en: He too was puzzled by the picture that had sparked Clemmons’s interest.
parts: 那幅引起克莱蒙斯兴趣的图像也让他感到困惑。

30.en: This jerk meant that kites could lift huge weights, Gharib realised.
parts: 加里布意识到，正是这一瞬间的猛拉，使风筝能够提起很重的东西。

34.en: There are no pictures showing the construction of the pyramids, so there is no way to tell what really happened.
parts: 没有图像描绘金字塔的建造过程，因此也无从确定当时究竟是怎样建造的。

36.en: Indeed, the experiments have left many specialists unconvinced.
parts: 事实上，许多专家看过这些实验后依然没有被说服。

38.en: Others feel there is more of a case for the theory.
parts: 另一些人则觉得，这个假说的依据比上述看法所认为的更充分。

51.en: So whether they were actually used to build the pyramids or not, it seems that kites may make sensible construction tools in the 21st century AD.
parts: 所以，不论古人是否真的用风筝建过金字塔，到了公元21世纪，风筝看来倒可能成为实用的建筑工具。

1.en: The disappointing results of many conventional road transport projects in Africa led some experts to rethink the strategy by which rural transport problems were to be tackled at the beginning of the 1980s.
parts: 非洲许多常规道路运输项目的成效令人失望。20世纪80年代初，一些专家因此重新思考解决农村交通问题的策略。

2.en: A request for help in improving the availability of transport within the remote Makete District of south-western Tanzania presented the opportunity to try a new approach.
parts: 坦桑尼亚西南部偏远的马凯特地区请求协助改善当地交通条件，这为尝试新办法提供了机会。

9.en: Road traffic was extremely rare within the district, and alternative means of transport were restricted to donkeys in the north of the district.
parts: 当地道路上极少有车辆通行。可选的其他运输方式，也只有这个地区北部使用的驴子。

13.en: The socio-economic survey of more than 400 households in the district indicated that a household in Makete spent, on average, seven hours a day on transporting themselves and their goods, a figure which seemed extreme but which has also been obtained in surveys in other rural areas in Africa.
parts: 对当地400多户家庭的社会经济调查显示，马凯特每户人家每天花在出行和运货上的时间平均为七小时。
这个数字看起来高得出奇，但在非洲其他农村地区的调查也得出了同样的数字。

14.en: Interesting facts regarding transport were found: 95% was on foot; 80% was within the locality; and 70% was related to the collection of water and firewood and travelling to grinding mills.
parts: 调查发现了一些值得注意的交通情况：95%的出行靠步行，80%在本地范围内，70%与取水、拾柴和前往磨坊有关。

21.en: Most goods were transported along the paths that provide short-cuts up and down the hillsides, but the paths were a real safety risk and made the journey on foot even more arduous.
parts: 大多数货物经由山坡上抄近路的小径运送，但这些小径确有安全隐患，也使步行更加艰难。

45.en: It would have been easy to criticise the MIRTP for using in the early phases a ‘top-down’ approach, in which decisions were made by experts and officials before being handed down to communities, but it was necessary to start the process from the level of the governmental authorities of the district.
parts: 人们很容易批评这个项目在早期采取了“自上而下”的办法：专家和官员先作决定，再将决定传达到社区。
但当时确实需要由地区政府这一层级来启动整个过程。

50.en: The concept of integrated rural transport is now well established in Tanzania, where a major program of rural transport is just about to start.
parts: 综合农村交通这一理念如今已在坦桑尼亚得到广泛认可，当地一项大型农村交通计划即将启动。

51.en: The experiences from Makete will help in this initiative, and Makete District will act as a reference for future work.
parts: 马凯特的经验将有助于这项计划，今后的工作也可以马凯特地区为参照。

46.en: It would have been difficult to respond to the requests of villagers and other rural inhabitants without the support and understanding of district authorities.
parts: 如果缺少地区主管部门的理解和支持，回应村民和其他农村居民的诉求本来会很困难。

4.en: The objective was to reduce the time and effort needed to obtain access to essential goods and services through an improved rural transport system.
parts: 项目旨在改善乡村交通，让居民能用更少的时间和力气获得基本物资和服务。

16.en: During Phase II, from January to February 1991, a number of approaches were implemented in an effort to improve mobility and access to transport.
parts: 在第二阶段，即1991年1月至2月，项目实施了多项措施，力求让居民出行更方便，也更容易使用交通服务。

17.en: An improvement of the road network was considered necessary to ensure the import and export of goods to the district.
parts: 为保证货物能运进和运出该地区，人们认为有必要改善道路网。

18.en: These improvements were carried out using methods that were heavily dependent on labour.
parts: 这些改善工程主要依靠人力完成。

22.en: It made sense to improve the paths by building steps, handrails and footbridges.
parts: 在这些小路上修台阶、装扶手、搭人行桥，是合乎情理的改进办法。

23.en: It was uncommon to find means of transport that were more efficient than walking but less technologically advanced than motor vehicles.
parts: 当地很少能见到一种交通工具，效率比步行高，技术却比机动车简单。

26.en: MIRTP focused on what would be most appropriate for the inhabitants of Makete in terms of what was available, how much they could afford and what they were willing to accept.
parts: 马凯特乡村综合交通项目从三方面考虑什么最适合当地居民：当地能得到什么、居民负担得起多少，以及他们愿意接受什么。

28.en: At the end of Phase II, it was clear that the selected approaches to Makete’s transport problems had had different degrees of success.
parts: 到第二阶段结束时，已经可以看出，为解决马凯特交通问题而选用的各种办法，成效并不相同。

30.en: The road improvements and accompanying maintenance system had helped make the district centre accessible throughout the year.
parts: 道路得到改善，又有配套的养护制度，人们因此一年四季都能到达该区的中心城镇。

32.en: Paths and secondary roads were improved only at the request of communities who were willing to participate in construction and maintenance.
parts: 只有社区愿意参与修建和养护，并主动提出请求，项目才会改善当地的小路和次要道路。

34.en: The efforts to improve the efficiency of the existing transport services were not very successful because most of the motorised vehicles in the district broke down and there were no resources to repair them.
parts: 提高现有运输服务效率的尝试成效不大，因为区内大多数机动车都出了故障，又没有资源维修。

37.en: Modifications to the original design by local carpenters cut production time and costs.
parts: 当地木匠改进了原来的设计，缩短了制作时间，也降低了成本。

40.en: Donkeys, which were imported to the district, have become more common and contribute, in particular, to the transportation of crops and goods to market.
parts: 从区外引进的驴如今在当地更常见了，尤其在把农作物和其他货物运往市场方面发挥着作用。

41.en: Those who have bought donkeys are mainly from richer households but, with an increased supply through local breeding, donkeys should become more affordable.
parts: 买驴的人大多来自较富裕的家庭，不过，随着本地繁殖使供应增加，驴应该会更容易买得起。

22.en: Without role signs, who is to know who has what role?
parts: 没有这些表明社会角色的标志，谁还能分清谁扮演什么角色呢？

15.en: In his Noctes Atticae or Greek Nights, Aulus Gellius describes ‘the pigeon of Archytas’, an invention dating back to about 360 BC.
parts: 奥卢斯·格利乌斯在《阿提卡之夜》（文中亦称《希腊之夜》）中描述了“阿尔基塔斯的鸽子”。
这项发明可追溯到约公元前360年。

15.en: Evidence gathered in recent years from anthropology and archaeology indicates that the region has supported a series of indigenous cultures for eleven thousand years; an extensive network of complex societies – some with populations perhaps as large as 100,000 – thrived there for more than 1,000 years before the arrival of Europeans.
parts: 近年来，人类学和考古学收集的证据表明，过去一万一千年间，这片地区先后孕育了多种本土文化。
在欧洲人到来之前，许多复杂社会在这里形成一个庞大的网络，繁盛了一千多年，其中一些社会的人口可能多达十万。

5.en: The following is a description of an important study conducted by the Institute for Social Research designed to answer these questions.
parts: 下面介绍的是社会研究所为回答这些问题而开展的一项重要研究。

6.en: A survey I conducted with Irene Whitney found that in British primary schools up to a quarter of pupils reported experience of bullying, which in about one in ten cases was persistent.
parts: 我与艾琳·惠特尼进行的调查发现，在英国小学，多达四分之一的学生报告曾遭受欺凌，
其中约十分之一的情况是持续发生的。

10.en: Victimised pupils are more likely to experience difficulties with interpersonal relationships as adults, while children who persistently bully are more likely to grow up to be physically violent, and convicted of anti-social offences.
parts: 受过欺凌的学生长大后更容易遇到人际关系方面的困难，
而那些持续欺凌他人的孩子，成年后更可能有暴力行为，也更可能因危害社会的违法行为而被定罪。

19.en: In Ireland, Guidelines on Countering Bullying Behaviour in Post-Primary Schools was published in 1993.
parts: 爱尔兰于1993年出版了《中学应对欺凌行为指南》。

25.en: The policy should be developed through consultation, over a period of time - not just imposed from the head teacher’s office!
parts: 这项政策应经过一段时间的协商制定，而不能只是由校长把政策强加给大家。

29.en: These are useful for raising awareness, and can best be tied in to early phases of development, while the school is starting to discuss the issue of bullying.
parts: 这些方法有助于提高大家对欺凌的认识，最好在制定对策之初、学校刚开始讨论欺凌问题时就把它们结合进来。

31.en: But curriculum work alone may only have short-term effects; it should be an addition to policy work, not a substitute.
parts: 不过，只靠课程教学，效果可能只能维持一时。课程应该补充学校的反欺凌政策，无法取代政策本身。

33.en: Assertiveness training for pupils who are liable to be victims is worthwhile, and certain approaches to group bullying such as ‘no blame’, can be useful in changing the behaviour of bullying pupils without confronting them directly, although other sanctions may be needed for those who continue with persistent bullying.
parts: 对容易受欺凌的学生，教他们坚定表达立场是值得的。应对集体欺凌时，一些方法（如“不责备法”）
有助于在避免正面对质的情况下改变施欺学生的行为，但对那些一再欺凌他人的学生，可能还需要其他惩戒措施。

35.en: One helpful step is to train lunchtime supervisors to distinguish bullying from playful fighting, and help them break up conflicts.
parts: 一种有帮助的做法是培训午间值勤人员，使他们分得清欺凌和嬉闹，并帮助他们及时制止冲突。

38.en: The more effort put in and the wider the whole school involvement, the more substantial the results are likely to be.
parts: 投入的精力越多，全校参与得越广泛，就越有可能取得显著成效。

5.en: Bullying can take a variety of forms, from the verbal - being taunted or called hurtful names - to the physical - being kicked or shoved - as well as indirect forms, such as being excluded from social groups.
parts: 欺凌有多种形式，既有言语上的，如被奚落或被起侮辱性的绰号，
也有肢体上的，如被踢或被推搡，还有间接形式，如被排斥在群体之外。

1.en: ‘I am from a large, poor family and for many years we have done without breakfast.
parts: “我家人口多，又很穷，多年来我们都吃不上早饭。

2.en: Ever since I joined the Street Kids International program I have been able to buy my family sugar and buns for breakfast.
parts: 自从参加了国际街头儿童组织的项目，我就有钱给家人买糖和小面包当早饭了。

3.en: I have also bought myself decent second-hand clothes and shoes.’
parts: 我还给自己买了像样的二手衣服和鞋子。”

4.en: ‘We’ve had business experience.
parts: “我们已经有了做生意的经验。

5.en: Now I’m confident to expand what we’ve been doing.
parts: 现在，我有信心把眼下的生意做大。

6.en: I’ve learnt cash management, and the way of keeping money so we save for re-investment.
parts: 我学会了管理现金，也学会了怎样把钱留存下来，用来再投资。

7.en: Now business is a part of our lives.
parts: 现在，做生意已经成了我们生活的一部分。

8.en: As well, we didn’t know each other before – now we’ve made new friends.’
parts: 还有，以前我们互不认识，现在却交上了新朋友。”

9.en: Participants in the Youth Skills Enterprise Initiative Program, Zambia
parts: 赞比亚青年创业技能项目的参与者

10.en: Although small-scale business training and credit programs have become more common throughout the world, relatively little attention has been paid to the need to direct such opportunities to young people.
parts: 尽管针对小生意的经营培训和信贷项目在世界各地日渐普遍，
人们却较少关注一个问题：有必要把这样的机会提供给年轻人。

11.en: Even less attention has been paid to children living on the streets or in difficult circumstances.
parts: 对生活在街头或处境艰难的儿童，人们的关注就更少了。

12.en: Over the past nine years, Street Kids International (S.K.I.) has been working with partner organisations in Africa, Latin America and India to support the economic lives of street children.
parts: 在过去九年里，国际街头儿童组织（S.K.I.）一直与非洲、拉丁美洲和印度的伙伴机构合作，帮助街头儿童谋生。

13.en: The purpose of this paper is to share some of the lessons S.K.I. and our partners have learned.
parts: 本文旨在分享我们国际街头儿童组织和合作伙伴积累的一些经验。

14.en: Typically, children do not end up on the streets due to a single cause, but to a combination of factors: a dearth of adequately funded schools, the demand for income at home, family breakdown and violence.
parts: 孩子流落街头通常有多种原因，
例如经费充足的学校太少、家里需要收入、家庭破裂以及暴力。

20.en: Many children may choose entrepreneurship because it allows them a degree of independence, is less exploitative than many forms of paid employment, and is flexible enough to allow them to participate in other activities such as education and domestic tasks.
parts: 许多孩子可能选择自己做生意，因为这样既有一定的自主性，又比许多受雇工作少受剥削，
时间也更灵活，还能上学、做家务。

21.en: S.K.I. has worked with partner organisations in Latin America, Africa and India to develop innovative opportunities for street children to earn income.
parts: 国际街头儿童组织与拉丁美洲、非洲和印度的伙伴机构合作，为街头儿童开辟新的谋生途径。

23.en: Participants in this enterprise were supplied with bicycles, which they used to deliver parcels and messages, and which they were required to pay for gradually from their wages.
parts: 参加这个项目的人领到自行车，用来递送包裹和消息，
车款则须从他们的工资中分期偿还。

30.en: The following lessons have emerged from the programs that S.K.I. and partner organisations have created.
parts: 以下经验来自国际街头儿童组织与伙伴机构开办的项目。

43.en: There is a need to recognise the importance of access to credit for impoverished young people seeking to fulfil economic needs.
parts: 我们需要认识到，对于努力维持生计的贫困青年来说，能够获得贷款十分重要。

2.en: He was arguing in favour of the position taken by Karl Popper in The Logic of Scientific Discovery (1972, 3rd edition) that the nature of scientific method is hypothetico-deductive and not, as is generally believed, inductive.
parts: 他是在支持卡尔·波普尔在《科学发现的逻辑》（1972年第三版）中提出的观点：
科学方法本质上采用的是假设演绎法，有别于人们普遍以为的归纳法。

1.en: ‘Hypotheses,’ said Medawar in 1964, ‘are imaginative and inspirational in character’; they are ‘adventures of the mind’.
parts: 梅达沃在1964年说，假设“具有想象力，能给人以启发”，是“思想的探险”。

1.en: It is a great deal easier to motivate employees in a growing organisation than a declining one.
parts: 在不断壮大的组织里激励员工，比在日渐衰退的组织里容易得多。

2.en: When organisations are expanding and adding personnel, promotional opportunities, pay rises, and the excitement of being associated with a dynamic organisation create feelings of optimism.
parts: 组织扩大规模、增聘人员时，晋升机会、加薪，以及身为一个充满活力的组织中的一员所带来的兴奋感，都会使人产生乐观情绪。

3.en: Management is able to use the growth to entice and encourage employees.
parts: 管理层可以利用组织的发展来吸引员工、激励员工。

4.en: When an organisation is shrinking, the best and most mobile workers are prone to leave voluntarily.
parts: 当组织规模缩小时，最优秀、也最能另谋职位的员工往往会主动离职。

5.en: Unfortunately, they are the ones the organisation can least afford to lose – those with the highest skills and experience.
parts: 可惜，技能最高、经验最丰富的这些人，恰恰是组织最经不起失去的人。

6.en: The minor employees remain because their job options are limited.
parts: 职位较低的员工会留下来，因为他们可以选择的工作有限。

18.en: High achievers will do best when the job provides moderately challenging goals and where there is independence and feedback.
parts: 成就出众的员工，在目标具有适度挑战性、工作有自主权且能得到反馈时，表现最好。

19.en: However, it should be remembered that not everybody is motivated by jobs that are high in independence, variety and responsibility.
parts: 不过要记住，自主性强、内容多样、责任重的工作，并不能激励所有人。

50.en: He believes that play creates a brain that has greater behavioural flexibility and improved potential for learning later in life.
parts: 他认为，玩耍能塑造大脑，使行为更灵活，也让人在今后具备更大的学习潜力。

34.en: For example, during the 1968 Olympics in Mexico City, a relatively unknown high jumper named Dick Fosbury won the gold by going over the bar backwards, in complete contradiction of all the received high-jumping wisdom, a move instantly dubbed the Fosbury flop.
parts: 例如，在1968年墨西哥城奥运会上，此前名气不大的跳高运动员迪克·福斯贝里背向横杆跃过，夺得金牌。
这个动作完全颠覆了传统跳高观念，立即被称为“福斯贝里背越式”。

7.en: The rich mixture of danger and detective work has also made it the perfect vehicle for fiction writers and film-makers, from Agatha Christie with Murder in Mesopotamia to Stephen Spielberg with Indiana Jones.
parts: 危险与侦探式调查巧妙交织，也使考古成为小说家和电影人理想的创作题材。
从阿加莎·克里斯蒂的《美索不达米亚谋杀案》，到史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格的《夺宝奇兵》，都是例子。

28.en: Moulds had to be carefully designed so that the molten Bakelite would flow evenly and completely into the mould.
parts: 模具必须经过精心设计，使熔融的电木均匀地流入模具，填满各个部位。

29.en: Sharp corners proved impractical and were thus avoided, giving rise to the smooth, ‘streamlined’ style popular in the 1930s.
parts: 事实证明，尖角在制作上行不通，因此设计时便避开了尖角，由此形成了20世纪30年代流行的那种圆滑的“流线型”风格。

30.en: The thickness of the walls of the mould was also crucial: thick walls took longer to cool and harden, a factor which had to be considered by the designer in order to make the most efficient use of machines.
parts: 模壁的厚度也至关重要：壁越厚，冷却变硬所需的时间越长。
设计者若要最大限度地提高机器利用效率，就必须考虑这一因素。
terms: make the most efficient use of
make the most efficient use of

34.en: A number of species are available from the CSIRO or through a small number of private breeders, most of whom were entomologists with the CSIRO’s dung beetle unit who have taken their specialised knowledge of the insect and opened small businesses in direct competition with their former employer.
parts: 有几种蜣螂可以从澳大利亚联邦科学与工业研究组织或少数私人繁育者那里获得。
这些繁育者大多曾是该组织蜣螂研究组的昆虫学家，后来利用自己的专业知识开办小企业，直接与原来的雇主竞争。
terms: 澳大利亚联邦科学与工业研究组织

24.en: Evidently, however, the blind not only figured out meanings for each line of motion, but as a group they generally came up with the same meaning at least as frequently as did sighted subjects.
parts: 然而，显然盲人受试者不仅能判断每种运动线条的含义，
而且，作为一个群体，他们给出相同解读的频率，通常至少和有视力的受试者一样高。
terms: 出现频率至少与……一样高

11.en: As an illustration of the health risks, in the case of a married couple where one partner is a smoker and one a non-smoker, the latter is believed to have a 30 per cent higher risk of death from heart disease because of passive smoking.
parts: 以健康风险为例，一对夫妻中，若一人吸烟、一人不吸烟，
据认为，不吸烟的一方会因被动吸烟而使死于心脏病的风险升高30%。

12.en: The risk of lung cancer also increases over the years of exposure and the figure jumps to 80 per cent if the spouse has been smoking four packs a day for 20 years.
parts: 接触二手烟的年数越长，患肺癌的风险也越高。如果配偶连续20年每天吸四包烟，文中给出的风险增幅会跃升至80%。

16.en: The report, published in the Journal of the American Medical Association (AMA), was based on the researchers’ own earlier research but also includes a review of studies over the past few years.
parts: 这份报告发表于《美国医学会杂志》，以研究人员自己此前的研究为基础，也综述了过去几年的其他研究。

20.en: Consequently, the effects of passive smoking are far greater on non-smokers than on smokers.
parts: 因此，就被动吸烟造成的影响而言，不吸烟者受到的影响远大于吸烟者。

21.en: This report emphasizes that cancer is not caused by a single element in cigarette smoke; harmful effects to health are caused by many components.
parts: 这份报告强调，香烟烟雾中致癌的成分并非只有一种，多种成分都会危害健康。

25.en: They argue that those scientists are underestimating the damage done by passive smoking and, in support of their recent findings, cite some previous research which points to passive smoking as the cause for between 30,000 and 60,000 deaths from heart attacks each year in the United States.
parts: 他们认为，那些科学家低估了被动吸烟造成的危害。为支持最近的研究结果，他们引用了此前的一些研究，
其中的证据指向被动吸烟：美国每年有3万至6万人因心脏病发作而死亡，可归因于被动吸烟。
